items.name: Himalayan Sunset Textured Art
items.desc:
A peaceful mountain landscape
Capture the beauty of a Himalayan sunset with dramatic mountain peaks, glowing orange skies, and shimmering lake reflections. Rich, expressive brushwork adds depth and warmth, creating a serene focal point for your living room or meditation space.

items.name: Ram Sita Watercolor Art
items.desc:
A devotional watercolor illustration
Celebrate the timeless bond of Lord Ram and Goddess Sita through delicate watercolor washes, vibrant accents, and graceful details. The airy white background gives this devotional artwork a light, elegant presence suited to a prayer room or peaceful corner.

items.name: Sacred Ghats Textured Art
items.desc:
A glowing riverside cityscape
Inspired by the spiritual beauty of India's sacred riverfronts, this artwork features temple silhouettes, boats, and golden reflections beneath a fiery sunset. Layered painterly strokes bring the scene to life with warmth, atmosphere, and depth.

items.name: Coastal Flow Textured Art
items.desc:
A calming abstract composition
Soft ivory tones blend with muted aqua and blue-green shades in this flowing abstract composition. Sculptural surface details evoke the movement of coastal water, bringing a fresh, tranquil feel to contemporary interiors.

items.name: Abstract Geometry Textured Art
items.desc:
Modern geometric abstraction
Neutral tones, bold dark marks, and a striking burgundy accent come together in this contemporary abstract artwork. Its layered forms and distressed-looking details create visual contrast, making it a distinctive addition to modern and minimalist spaces.

items.name: Desert Horizon Textured Art
items.desc:
An earthy abstract landscape
Inspired by open desert horizons, this artwork combines sandy neutrals, terracotta shades, and muted charcoal mountain forms. Its layered, expressive surface creates a warm and grounded atmosphere that complements natural materials and understated interiors.

items.name: Krishna Radha Textured Art
items.desc:
A timeless divine connection
This expressive depiction of Radha and Krishna pairs deep blue tones with warm ochre, gold, and cream. Flowing forms and bold contours highlight their divine connection, creating a devotional statement piece with a contemporary artistic character.

items.name: Ocean Layers Textured Art
items.desc:
An abstract study of sea and sand
Deep ocean blues, soft turquoise, and sandy ivory flow together in layered diagonal forms. The raised-looking surface and natural color transitions evoke the meeting of sea and shore, offering a sophisticated accent for modern interiors.

items.name: Golden Shore Textured Art
items.desc:
A warm coastal sunset
Golden sunlight spreads across the shoreline as deep teal waves meet a softly illuminated beach. Textural brushwork enhances the contrast between the sea, sand, and glowing sky, bringing the warmth of a coastal evening into your home.

items.name: Ganesha Heritage Textured Art
items.desc:
A traditional motif with a modern finish
Featuring Lord Ganesha in rich gold, charcoal, and ivory tones, this artwork blends traditional symbolism with a bold decorative composition. Its visibly layered, relief-like details give it a distinctive presence in elegant living spaces and devotional settings.

items.name: Krishna Radiance Textured Art
items.desc:
A striking portrait of Krishna
Deep blue tones and luminous saffron accents define this powerful depiction of Lord Shiva. Bold painterly marks and contrasting colors create an energetic visual impact, making this artwork a meaningful focal point for devotional and contemporary spaces.

items.name: Shiva Eternal Textured Art
items.desc:
A bold spiritual statement
This dramatic portrait of Lord Shiva combines midnight blue, fiery orange, and golden highlights with symbolic elements including the crescent moon and trident. Strong contrasts and expressive surface details evoke strength, stillness, and timeless spiritual energy.

items.name: Hanuman Divine Watercolor Art
items.desc:
A devotional watercolor portrait
Lord Hanuman is portrayed with a dignified expression, traditional ornaments, and a rich saffron palette. Loose watercolor washes and colorful splashes lend the artwork a lively, expressive character that suits a prayer room or spiritual collection.

items.name: Hanuman Textured Art
items.desc:
A tranquil mountain-inspired abstract
Muted mountain silhouettes meet earthy rust and warm ivory tones in this atmospheric landscape. Layered marks and subtle surface variation give the composition a natural, weathered character, ideal for calm and contemporary interiors.

items.name: Krishna Radha Sunset Textured Art
items.desc:
A romantic devotional landscape
Radha and Krishna sit beside a glowing river as the setting sun reflects across the water. Warm amber light, deep silhouettes, and expressive brushwork create a contemplative scene celebrating devotion, companionship, and serenity.

items.name: Hanuman Valor Textured Art
items.desc:
A powerful devotional portrait
Lord Hanuman is portrayed with a determined gaze, ornate golden crown, and vibrant saffron and amber highlights. Bold strokes and dramatic contrasts emphasize courage, devotion, and strength, creating a commanding addition to a spiritual art collection.

items.name: Shiva Serenity Watercolor Art
items.desc:
A peaceful watercolor interpretation
This serene portrayal of Lord Shiva uses cool blue washes, delicate detailing, and soft water-inspired forms to evoke calm and contemplation. Its light background and flowing composition make it well suited to meditation spaces and devotional interiors.

items.name: Golden Lotus Path Textured Art
items.desc: A large ivory lotus with golden detailing emerges from flowing, layered forms. Small golden footprints lead toward the flower, creating a symbolic composition associated with peace, purity, and spiritual growth.

items.name: Moonlit Ocean Textured Art
items.desc: A dramatic moonlit seascape with deep charcoal-blue clouds, warm golden highlights, and shimmering reflections across the water. The contrast creates a calm yet striking focal point.

items.name: Golden Moon River Textured Art
items.desc: A winding ivory river flows through deep forest-green hills beneath a luminous golden moon. Raised-looking textures and fine gold accents give this composition an elegant, contemplative feel.

items.name: Golden Mountain Dawn Textured Art
items.desc: Layered mountain peaks in warm beige and earthy brown tones rise beneath a golden sun. Textural ridges and subtle metallic-looking accents create depth and a serene natural atmosphere.

items.name: Golden Tree of Life Textured Art
items.desc: A branching tree with golden leaves spreads across a warm neutral background. Sculptural-looking branches, delicate leaf details, and a circular golden motif create a luxurious nature-inspired statement.

items.name: Ocean Wave Layers Textured Art
items.desc: Flowing layers of deep navy, teal, and ivory evoke powerful ocean waves. The contrast between dark water and pale foam gives the abstract composition movement and a refreshing coastal character.

items.name: Golden Blossom Sunset Textured Art
items.desc: A delicate flowering tree frames a glowing golden sunset above reflective water. Soft cream textures and metallic-looking golden details create a peaceful, refined landscape.

items.name: Ivory Flow Abstract Textured Art
items.desc: Organic flowing forms in ivory, cream, and sand create a minimalist abstract composition. Subtle tonal variation and layered surface details bring understated elegance to contemporary interiors.

items.name: Golden Moon Phases Textured Art
items.desc: A sequence of moon phases combines charcoal, ivory, and gold tones in a balanced celestial design. The circular forms and textured surfaces make this piece a distinctive accent for modern spaces.

items.name: Earth Tones Cracked Texture Art
items.desc: Warm terracotta, rust, taupe, and cream shapes meet in a cracked-earth-inspired abstract. Golden-looking seams emphasize the organic pattern and create a rich, earthy visual effect.

items.name: Serene Buddha Textured Art
items.desc: A peaceful Buddha portrait in muted beige and taupe is framed by a golden halo. Fine facial details, patterned hair, and layered textures give the devotional artwork a calm, meditative presence.

items.name: Golden Horizon Sunset Textured Art
items.desc: A glowing sun rests on the horizon above a softly rippled sea and layered neutral-toned shore. Golden highlights and textured strokes evoke the quiet beauty of sunset.

items.name: Golden Moon Owls Textured Art
items.desc: Two owls sit close together on a fine branch before a large golden moon and deep forest-green background. Warm neutral feathers and delicate gold accents create a serene, intimate composition.

items.name: Desert Horizon Abstract Art Work
items.desc: Warm terracotta, sand and peach tones form a layered abstract landscape. Soft textures and flowing horizontal strokes bring a calm, warm and sophisticated feel to the space.

items.name: Sacred Geometry Abstract Art Work
items.desc: Cream, rust, mustard and deep green geometric shapes create a balanced composition. Curved forms and symmetry give this artwork a bold, contemporary character.

items.name: Tree of Life Abstract Art Work
items.desc: Golden branches, intricate roots and jewel-toned leaves stand out against a deep navy background. The design evokes growth, connection and harmony.

items.name: Golden Ascent Abstract Art Work
items.desc: Ascending rectangular forms shift from charcoal to golden beige, suggesting progress and ambition. Its textured neutral palette suits modern, minimal interiors.

items.name: Golden Connections Abstract Art Work
items.desc: Golden lines and circular nodes create an interconnected pattern across a textured emerald-green background, evoking relationships and modern sophistication.

items.name: Ocean Layers Abstract Art Work
items.desc: Layered navy, slate blue and icy-white brushstrokes evoke ocean waves and distant horizons. Cool colours create a peaceful, refreshing atmosphere.

items.name: Archway Harmony Abstract Art Work
items.desc: Overlapping arches in terracotta, olive, mustard and cream create an architectural abstract. Repeating curves add depth and balance.

items.name: Ember Glow Abstract Art Work
items.desc: Expressive layers of orange, coral, peach and deep rust create a sunset-like warmth. Textured brushwork gives the artwork energetic character.

items.name: Moonlit Grove Abstract Art Work
items.desc: Golden deer, a luminous moon and turquoise trees form a magical night-forest scene. Decorative details and a dark-blue backdrop create a distinctive statement piece.

items.name: Solar Mandala Abstract Art Work
items.desc: An ivory geometric mandala sits against a rust-orange background. Repeating shapes and a central sun motif create symmetry and a striking focal point.

items.name: Urban Rhythm Abstract Art Work
items.desc: Geometric buildings in navy, rust red, cream and gold depict a modern cityscape. Art Deco-inspired forms add a bold, sophisticated touch to urban interiors.

items.name: Alpine Wildflower Valley
items.desc: Snow-capped mountain peaks rise above rolling green meadows filled with vibrant pink, yellow, purple and white wildflowers. A sparkling stream winds through the valley, creating a cheerful, refreshing nature-inspired scene.

items.name: Golden Lotus Serenity
items.desc: Graceful pink and ivory lotus flowers bloom among deep teal lily pads, illuminated by shimmering golden reflections. Rich painterly textures and warm highlights evoke the peaceful beauty of a tranquil pond.

items.name: Himalayan Golden Hour
items.desc: Majestic Himalayan peaks glow beneath a luminous golden-orange sky as sunlight touches their snowy ridges. Layered blue mountains, rugged rocks and colorful prayer flags capture the serenity and grandeur of a high-altitude landscape.

items.name: Autumn Lake Reflections
items.desc: Fiery autumn foliage frames a peaceful lake where a traditional wooden boat rests on reflective water. Misty mountain peaks and warm sunset tones create a captivating scene inspired by the quiet beauty of autumn.

items.name: Desert Dusk Serenity
items.desc: Sweeping terracotta and amber dunes glow beneath a dramatic setting sun. A distant camel caravan and historic desert fort add depth and character, capturing the timeless charm of a warm desert horizon.

items.name: Enchanted Forest of Life
items.desc: A richly decorated tree shelters a vibrant peacock, graceful deer and a watchful owl amid jewel-toned foliage. Inspired by traditional folk-art motifs, the composition celebrates wildlife, growth and the interconnected beauty of nature.

items.name: Misty Evergreen Lake
items.desc: Dense evergreen forests fade into soft layers of mist surrounding a still mountain lake. Muted blue-green tones and delicate reflections create a serene, minimalist landscape that brings a sense of calm to contemporary interiors.

items.name: Sunlit Mountain Majesty
items.desc: Towering snow-covered mountains catch the fiery glow of a setting sun, revealing dramatic textures in gold, slate blue and lavender. Dark pine silhouettes anchor the foreground, creating a bold and uplifting alpine landscape.

items.name: Kerala Backwater Glow
items.desc: A traditional houseboat glides across tranquil tropical backwaters framed by swaying palms and lush greenery. Peach and golden sunset reflections shimmer across the water, celebrating the peaceful charm of India's tropical landscapes.

items.name: Banyan Tree at Sunset
items.desc: An ancient banyan tree spreads its magnificent branches and hanging roots beneath a glowing orange sunset. A quiet village, grazing cattle and a reflective pond evoke rural life and the enduring connection between people and nature.

items.name: Golden Horizon Horses
items.desc: A herd of white horses running through golden grass beneath a glowing sunset, with layered mountains in the distance.

items.name: Radha Krishna Divine Love
items.desc: A devotional portrait of Radha and Krishna in a tender, peaceful moment, decorated with lotus flowers and gold accents.

items.name: Golden Tree of Life
items.desc: A sculptural tree with gold and ivory leaves against a deep navy textured background.

items.name: Autumn Falls Serenity
items.desc: A waterfall framed by autumn foliage, layered mountains, and a warm sunset sky.

items.name: Emerald Canyon Waterfall
items.desc: A tall waterfall flowing between deep green canyon walls beneath a golden sun.

items.name: Sacred White Cow
items.desc: A traditional decorative painting of a resting white cow with ornate gold jewelry, lotus flowers, and a golden arch.

items.name: Buddha of Quiet Wisdom
items.desc: A serene Buddha portrait in ivory, stone, and antique gold tones with a softly weathered textured background.

items.name: Golden Lotus Bloom
items.desc: An ivory lotus with gold-edged petals and deep green leaves, rendered in a richly textured style.

items.name: Lotus of Golden Light
items.desc: A luminous cream-and-gold lotus in full bloom above dark foliage against a neutral textured backdrop.

items.name: Golden Lake Horizon
items.desc: A panoramic mountain-and-lake scene with a large golden sun reflected across still water.

items.name: Golden Mountain Lake
items.desc: A vertical mountain lake landscape with golden sunlight, autumn trees, layered peaks, and reflective water.

items.name: Shiva & Shakti – The Eternal Divine Bond
items.desc: This devotional artwork represents the divine connection between Lord Shiva and Goddess Shakti. The blue hand symbolizes Lord Shiva, decorated with sacred Tripundra and Rudraksha beads, gently holding the feet of the Goddess. The Trishul and Damru in the background represent Shiva's divine power and cosmic energy. The artwork beautifully expresses love, devotion, respect, and the eternal bond between Shiva and Shakti.

items.name: Maa Lakshmi – The Goddess of Abundance
items.desc: This beautiful traditional artwork depicts Goddess Lakshmi seated gracefully on a blooming pink lotus. She holds lotus flowers in her hands, symbolizing purity, beauty, and spiritual enlightenment. Her golden crown and ornaments represent divine richness, while her blessing gestures symbolize prosperity, happiness, peace, and abundance. The golden halo surrounding her reflects her divine energy and spiritual power.

items.name: Misty Mountain Peaks
items.desc: Handcrafted charcoal-style sketch of layered misty peaks and pine forest, adding dramatic depth and serene wilderness charm to living spaces.

items.name: Eternal Swan Embrace
items.desc: Elegant pencil artwork of a black and white swan pair forming a heart under moonlight, symbolizing eternal love and harmony.

items.name: Golden Sunset Flight
items.desc: Serene charcoal drawing of a glowing sunset over calm ocean waves with birds in flight, radiating peace and quiet beauty.

items.name: Sailing Into Sunset
items.desc: Handcrafted sketch of a sailing ship gliding past misty coastal hills at sunset, evoking adventure, calm and timeless wanderlust.

items.name: Lone Oak Silhouette
items.desc: Minimalist pencil artwork of a solitary oak tree silhouetted against a golden sunset field, reflecting solitude, strength and quiet grace.

items.name: Seven Horses Stampede
items.desc: Dynamic charcoal sketch of seven galloping horses racing through dust and clouds, symbolizing speed, strength and prosperity for Vastu spaces.

items.name: Flight of Wild Geese
items.desc: Graceful pencil drawing of wild geese flying in formation across a cloudy sky, symbolizing unity, freedom and auspicious togetherness.

items.name: Elephant Mother and Calf
items.desc: Touching silhouette artwork of a mother elephant guiding her calf at dusk, representing family bond, protection and Vastu harmony.

items.name: Spirit Rising Free
items.desc: Expressive charcoal portrait of a figure releasing smoke-like energy skyward, symbolizing liberation, spirituality and inner peace.

items.name: Pathway Into the Light
items.desc: Atmospheric sketch of a wooden rope bridge vanishing into glowing fog, representing journey, hope and the path toward light.
